purpose: Maps each scientific marginal-value candidate to what Claude's architecture/Pareto track may and may not infer from it. Read-only synthesis of already-frozen scientific artifacts - no new experiments, no engineering decisions.

candidates.canonical_effect: A_cap->B +0.605 bpm MAE improvement; C->B +0.776 bpm
candidates.uncertainty: sample SD (ddof=1) 0.310 bpm across 5 seeds (SEED_VARIABILITY, not population CI)
candidates.heterogeneity: no single subject or activity dominates (results/ppg_dalia_sensitivity_day11.json)
candidates.major_limitation: single dataset, small (3-subject) capacity-matched evaluation, modest absolute magnitude (~0.6 bpm)
candidates.architecture_relevance: supports IMU inclusion as informative for HR estimation under motion, at modest magnitude
claude_must_not_infer: that the ORIGINAL uncontrolled ~1.88bpm/20.6% figure is valid
that this justifies a specific IMU sampling rate/duty cycle for hardware

candidates.heterogeneity: 2/4 subjects favor candidate; excluding s2 alone flips the aggregate sign
candidates.major_limitation: n=4 is too small for any population inference; single most fragile result in the project
candidates.architecture_relevance: supports DEPRIORITIZING a second PPG site for this target - but the evidence is weak enough that this should be read as 'no support found', not 'proven harmful'
claude_may_use: explicit disclosure that it is n=4/s2-sensitive
claude_must_not_infer: second PPG site is globally useless
that removing it is scientifically mandated (it is only unsupported, not disproven for all uses)

candidates.canonical_effect: primary A->B +0.0220 macro-F1; secondary holdout A->B +0.0328; both C->B positive (5/5 and 5/5)
candidates.uncertainty: sample SD (ddof=1), n=3 (primary) and n=8 (secondary) subjects, kept separate
candidates.heterogeneity: primary: concentrated in SC4011; secondary: distributed (max subject share 41%)
candidates.major_limitation: single dataset/recording protocol throughout; N3 class regresses (precision 0.499->0.430) even as overall macro-F1 improves
candidates.architecture_relevance: the most rigorously validated positive result in the project - supports EOG inclusion for sleep-stage classification specifically, with a known N3 tradeoff
claude_may_use: direction and magnitude for BOTH cohorts, kept separate
the N3 regression as an explicit, disclosed tradeoff
the control result as evidence the effect is alignment-specific, not just channel-presence
claude_must_not_infer: that a shared head-module AFE channel budget for EOG is scientifically mandated by this result (that's an engineering/BOM decision, not implied by the science)

candidates.canonical_effect: interaction term +0.0031 +- 0.0434 (2/5 seeds positive, 3/5 negative); Resp alone (M_B) mean -0.0140 vs. EEG-only
candidates.uncertainty: n=5 seeds, n=3 subjects; SD ~14x the mean
candidates.heterogeneity: heterogeneous across both seeds and subjects (results/sleep_interaction_sensitivity_day11.json)
candidates.control: capacity-fairness safeguard (constant per-channel parameter cost), no negative control for Resp itself
candidates.major_limitation: single interaction pair tested; Resp alone shows no clear benefit; result is genuinely noisy, not just 'small'
candidates.architecture_relevance: does NOT support adding a respiratory channel for this target based on current evidence; does not rule it out either
claude_may_use: the fact that a clean interaction feasibility audit and one experiment were completed
the unresolved classification exactly as stated
claude_must_not_infer: that respiratory sensing is validated or invalidated for any target - this experiment is sleep-stage-specific

cross_cutting_rule: Every 'claude_may_use' entry is a scientific finding, not an engineering conclusion. Sensor inclusion/exclusion, sampling rate, duty cycle, and BOM decisions remain Claude's/the architecture-gate's to make, informed by but not dictated by this map.
